text.title: Switch call records against billed usage
text.lede: For every call found on both sides, how many seconds billing differs from the switch. Agreement piles up at zero. One second either way is rounding. Anything further out is a break, and a spike away from zero means a rule, not noise.
text.chartTitle: Billed seconds minus switch seconds, per call
text.chartSub: Voice calls on 30 March 2026. The grey band is the one-second tolerance. Bar heights are compressed so the tails stay visible. Select a bar.
text.unmatchedSub: These have no difference to plot.
text.leftOnlyDesc: On the switch, never billed. Revenue is leaking.
text.rightOnlyDesc: Billed with no switch record. A customer could dispute these.
text.dupDesc: Rated twice in billing from one switch record.
